record_title: The exponent of an abelian p-group from its modular zero-divisor graph
provenance: Scientific theorem, proof, literature comparison, and review evidence only.
limitations: The exponent formula requires G to be abelian; the Frobenius step uses commutativity of KG.
The rank-two isomorphism corollary is stated over the prime field F_p, matching the hypothesis of the cited rank-determination theorem.
Order, rank, and exponent do not classify arbitrary finite abelian p-groups, so the general modular isomorphism problem remains open.
Originality is to the best of our knowledge; because the proof is short and uses standard facts, an implicit or differently phrased antecedent in unindexed literature remains possible.
